finalResult.nextParagraphText: “Or mental manipulation at an unprecedented level,” Gudrun shook her head. “I’m not claiming I have an answer, just that we need to consider something in that vein. For someone’s personality to change so drastically and for four gods to willingly end their own existence doesn’t make much sense. In what world would Bolomund, the independent Godking who refused to join any factions, suddenly decide to join up with these people and become loyal to the level where he’ll willingly end his own life at their command?”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “That it wasn’t the Oakspear Monarch… not truly,” Gudrun shook her head.
